summary: The root نَصَفَ (naṣafa) primarily means to do justice, act equitably, or give someone their due right. It implies fairness and rectitude in dealings, ensuring that what is owed is rendered.
lane: 4 أَنَصَفَهُ ذ He did justice to him: (MA:) he acted equitably with him: (Msb:) he gave him, or obtained for him, his right, or due, from ( مِنْ ) another: see أَعْذَرَ . -b2- إِنْصاَفٌ The giving what is right, or due: (M:) or the granting, or rendering, justice. (KL, PS.) -b3- أَنْصَفَهُ مِنْ ظَالِمِهِ [ He exacted justice for him from his wronger ]. (T voce ظَلَّمَ .)

headwords.gloss: He did justice to him; he acted equitably with him; he gave him

parts.t: He exacted justice for him from his wronger

headwords.def: أَنَصَفَهُ He did justice to him: (MA:) he acted equitably with him: (Msb:) he gave him, or obtained for him, his right, or due, from ( مِنْ ) another: see أَعْذَرَ . إِنْصاَفٌ The giving what is right, or due: (M:) or the granting, or rendering, justice. (KL, PS.) أَنْصَفَهُ مِنْ ظَالِمِهِ [ He exacted justice for him from his wronger ]. (T voce ظَلَّمَ .)

headwords.gloss: He exacted; obtained, his right; due, from him

parts.t: completely, so that each of them became on a par with the other;

headwords.def: اِنْتَصَفَ مِنْهُ He exacted, or obtained, his right, or due, from him (M, K) completely, so that each of them became on a par with the other; (K;) [i. e. with equity ]. اِنْتَصَفَ It became halved: (Msb:) [often said of the daytime ( النَّهَارُ )].

headwords.gloss: was boiled until half of it had gone, or evaporated

parts.t: was boiled until half of it had gone, or evaporated.

headwords.def: طُبِخَ عَلَى النِّصْفِ , and أُصْلِحَ على النصف , It (wine) was boiled until half of it had gone, or evaporated. (TA, voce طَابَة .)

headwords.gloss: A place half-way, midway; equidistant, between two places; middle-aged
headwords.def: مَكَانٌ نَصَفٌ بَيْنَ مَكَانَيْنِ [ A place half-way, midway, or equidistant, between two places ]. (Mughnee in art. سَوَآءٌ .) نَصَفٌ A middle-aged woman or man: (S, K:) or forty-five years old: or fifty years old. (K.) Dim. نُصيف .
نَصِيفٌ A woman's muffler: see خِمَارٌ .
نُصَيْفٌ , dim. of نَصَفٌ : see خَلَيْقٌ voce خَلَقٌ .

parts.t: cooked until half of it has gone

headwords.def: مُنَصَّفٌ Expressed juice, (Mgh, Msb,) or wine, or beverage, (K,) cooked until half of it has gone [by evaporation ]. (Mgh, Msb, K.)
مَنَاصَفٌ Not wholly ripe: [ half-ripe: ] applied to the date. (TA, voce بُسْرٌ .)

headwords.gloss: Half-bricks; cut bricks, whereof the one is placed, in building, beside the whole brick, for the purpose of ornamentation

parts.t: cut bricks, whereof the one is placed, in building, beside the whole brick, for the purpose of ornamentation.

headwords.def: أَنْصاَفُ اللَّبِنِ [ Half-bricks, or] cut bricks, whereof the one is placed, in building, beside the whole brick, for the purpose of ornamentation. (Msb in art. خرج .)
